questions.prompt: Cutoff opens, button calls, you are the big blind with QQ. What do you do?

choices.text: Check preflop, which is not an option after a raise

questions.explanation: Queens do not flat multiway out of position. Squeeze.

questions.prompt: Hijack opens, cutoff calls, you are on the button with 76s and 100bb. A sound default?

choices.text: Cold-call and play fit-or-fold in position
Fold. Suited connectors cannot call a single raise.

questions.explanation: In position against a non-early open, 76s can take a flop. It is not a 100bb jam.

questions.prompt: UTG opens, two players call, you are in the small blind with ATo. Best default?

choices.text: Call. More players means defend wider with any ace.
Fold. Your ace is dominated and you are out of position multiway.

questions.explanation: ATo hates a strong early range plus two callers from the worst seat.

questions.prompt: You squeeze and both opponents call. On a dry flop with no pair, you should…

choices.text: Ignore that the pot is multiway
Bluff less. Two callers reduced your fold equity.

questions.explanation: A squeeze that gets called twice is a made-hand pot, not a pure bluff pot.
